title: Choose the next step
instructions: Read what happened, then choose the best answer.

parts.prompt: Dina made several knowledge mistakes with word patterns. What is the most useful next step?

options.text: Read much faster in the next test
Skip this question type next time
Learn the patterns and try new items

choice_rationales.A: Speed does not teach patterns she does not know.
choice_rationales.B: Checking helps attention mistakes, not missing knowledge.
choice_rationales.C: Skipping loses marks and teaches nothing.
choice_rationales.D: Knowledge mistakes need learning and then new practice.

parts.correct_explanation: Learning the patterns and trying new items fixes a knowledge gap.
